description: Show the current automatic top-up settings: whether it is on, the balance that triggers a charge, and how much is charged. Use when the user asks what their auto top-up is set to, before changing it so you can state what is changing, or when a wallet was topped up with nobody present and they want to know why. Read-only and free — configure_auto_topup is what changes them, and calling that to find out the current values would alter the unattended spending you were only trying to read.
name: get_auto_topup
